nai.positive: ink wash painting, sumi-e, traditional media, brush strokes, ink splatter, limited palette, spot color, paper texture, high contrast
nai.negative: 3d, photorealistic, cel shading, glossy, vibrant colors, gradient

gpt.style: Ink-and-wash illustration (sumi-e): confident wet brush strokes, ink bleeding into textured rice paper, mostly greys and blacks with one restrained accent colour, generous negative space.
gpt.avoid: Avoid glossy digital rendering, photographic realism and saturated colour.
